alias: Defiant: refresh location name from Signal K position
description: Hourly (sailboats don't move fast enough to need more often): reverse-geocodes the live Signal K GPS fix and updates input_text.defiant_location_name. Prefers a nearby marina/yacht club name (rest_command.defiant_reverse_geocode_search, a bounded Nominatim POI search) and falls back to neighbourhood/city (rest_command.defiant_reverse_geocode_fallback, a plain reverse lookup) when nothing marina-like is nearby, e.g. at anchor. Independent of automation.defiant_signalk_set_system_location, which keeps the actual lat/long (and therefore weather.forecast_home) live on every GPS update -- this automation only refreshes the human-readable label.

variables.location_name: {% set search = geo_search.content %}{% set named = (search | rejectattr('name', 'equalto', '') | list) if search is iterable else [] %}{% if named | count > 0 %}{{ named[0].get('name') }}{% else %}{% set fb = geo_fallback.content %}{% set addr = fb.get('address', {}) %}{% set locality = addr.get('neighbourhood') or addr.get('hamlet') or addr.get('suburb') or addr.get('village') or fb.get('name') %}{% set city = addr.get('city') or addr.get('town') %}{% if locality and city %}{{ locality }}, {{ city }}{% elif city %}{{ city }}{% elif locality %}{{ locality }}{% else %}{{ fb.get('display_name', 'Unknown') }}{% endif %}{% endif %}
